entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand GPS Tracker. Order number is 77-B-451.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Let me just pull up order 77-B-451...
Just tell me yes or no. Can I return it?
I see the order right here. I just have one or two verification questions. The VeloBand GPS Tracker was delivered on December 15th, is that correct?
Sounds right. So, can I return it?
I can definitely check on the return eligibility. First, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It works fine. Honestly, I just changed my mind. It was an impulse buy and I just don't use it. I don't have time for some complicated resale process, I just want my money back.
I understand completely. Thank you for clarifying. Let me just review the policy for this item. One moment, please.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I've double-checked, and I see you're well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you.
Great. Finally. What do I need to do?

I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be issued to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
